1.w: Scales of deceit [are] an abomination to YHWH, and a whole stone [is] His delight.

2.w: Pride has come, and shame also comes, and with the humble [is] wisdom.

3.w: The integrity of the upright ones guides them, and the perversity of the treacherous ones destroys them.

4.w: Wealth will not profit in the day of wrath, and righteousness delivers from death.

5.w: The righteousness of a blameless one makes his way straight, and in his wickedness a wicked one will fall.

6.w: The righteousness of the upright ones will deliver them, and by their own desires those acting treacherously are captured.

7.w: With the death of a wicked man, expectation perishes, and the hope of his vigor perishes.

8.w: A righteous one is drawn out from distress, and it comes to the wicked in his place.

9.w: With the mouth a godless one destroys his neighbor, and with knowledge righteous ones will be delivered.

10.w: In the good of the righteous ones a city rejoices, and in the destruction of wicked ones [is] a shout of joy.

11.w: By the blessing of the upright a city is lifted high, and by the mouth of the wicked ones it is torn down.

12.w: The one despising his neighbor [is] lacking of heart, and a man of understanding keeps quiet.

13.w: One going about slandering is revealing secret counsel, and the one faithful of spirit conceals the matter.

14.w: Without counsels, a people falls, and salvation [is] in many giving counsel.

15.w: One will surely suffer evil if he pledges for [for] a stranger, and one who hates striking hands remains secure.

16.w: A woman of grace grasps honor, and the ruthless ones grasp riches.

17.w: A man of kindness deals well [with] his soul, and a cruel one troubles his flesh.

18.w: A wicked one makes a reward of deception, and the one sowing righteousness [has] a wage of truth.

19.w: Rightly [is] righteousness for life, and the one pursuing evil [is] unto his own death.

20.w: The crooked of heart are an abomination to YHWH, and those blameless in [their] way [are] His delight.

21.w: Hand to hand, a wicked one is not acquitted, and the seed of the righteous will escape [punishment].

22.w: A ring of gold in the nose of a pig, [is] a beautiful woman lacking discretion.

23.w: The desire of the righteous [is] only good, and the hope of the wicked [is] wrath.

24.w: There is one dispersing, and increasing more, and one withholding from uprightness, only for lack.

25.w: A soul of blessing is made fat, and the one who drenches, he also will sprout.

26.w: The one withholding grain, the people will curse him, and blessing [is] on the head of the one selling.

27.w: The one earnestly seeking good seeks favor, and the one seeking evil, it will come to him.

28.w: The one trusting in his riches, he will fall, and the righteous ones will sprout like the leaf.

29.w: The one troubling his own house will inherit the wind, and the fool [is] servant to the wise of heart.

30.w: The fruit of a righteous one [is] a tree of life, and the one taking souls [is] wise.

31.w: Behold, a righteous one will be repaid in the land, surely also the ungodly and the sinner!
